items.title: Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU
items.summary: Meituan has released the weights for LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter model built for AI agents and trained entirely on Chinese hardware. On Terminal Bench, it scores 88.4 points, landing just behind Claude Opus 5. The sample deployment runs on 194 Huawei Ascend chips, and Meituan makes no mention of Nvidia GPUs....

items.title: Runway's open-source Praxis-1 turns video AI into a robot controller
items.summary: Runway releases its robotics model Praxis-1 with open weights and source code under the Apache 2.0 license. The model uses knowledge from video training for robot control and leads the World Action Model category on Nvidia's RoboLab-120 benchmark. It can't yet plan complex action sequences on its own, though....

items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon takes the MathArena crown but costs 15 times more than GPT-6.1 Sol
items.summary: For the first time in a while, no OpenAI model leads the MathArena AI math benchmark. Google's Gemini 4 Carbon and Anthropic's Fable 5.2 have knocked GPT-6.1 Sol from the top, though both cost significantly more. Gemini ignored the time limit in testing and almost never gave up on a task. The article Gemini 4 Carbon takes the MathArena crown but costs 15 times more than GPT-6.1 Sol appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: OpenAI reassigns robotics researchers to other teams as general-purpose models might make specialized robotics AI unnecessary
items.summary: OpenAI is dissolving its standalone robotics team for the second time, but not because it lacks data. General-purpose models like GPT-6 Astra can apparently control robots directly, making a dedicated unit unnecessary. The researchers are being redistributed across other teams in what the company frames as a way to accelerate its robotics efforts....

items.title: Anthropic Outlines its AI-Powered Code Review Process for Claude Code
items.summary: Anthropic has outlined how the Claude Code team handles code reviews as AI agents increasingly contribute to its codebase. The approach relies on multiple layers of automated verification, AI-powered reviews, and risk-based human approval, aiming to reduce manual review time without increasing regressions or production incidents. By Robert Krzaczyński

items.title: ChatGPT’s new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you
items.summary: ChatGPT Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out on users' behalf, starting with a limited rollout to U.S. Pro subscribers.

items.title: Where was Nvidia’s security team?
items.summary: Nvidia’s security chief quietly left in August, and now that CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down over his relationships, including one with an executive at a company suspected of funneling chips to China, a former intelligence officer says it’s the kind of leak that runs everyday conversations, which most corporate security teams are poorly equipped to catch.
